description: Defines the template class StaticContainedRangeMap, which manages ranges of addresses and associated entries, wrapping a StaticMap and providing range retrieval functionality. It is part of the breakpad processor component.

classes.name: StaticContainedRangeMap
classes.description: A range map that wraps a StaticMap to manage address ranges and their entries, supporting retrieval of the most specific descendant range for a given address.

methods.name: RetrieveRange
methods.description: Retrieves the most specific (smallest) descendant range encompassing the specified address, returning false if none found.
